headlines.title: 서울 아파트거래 22%가 6억 이하 …정책대출 커트라인에 몰렸다
headlines.summary: 1만709건 거래…전년동기比 11% 급등 6억 초과하면 디딤돌대출 등 못 받아 매수세에 가격↑…“저가 아파트 소멸” 올해 서울에서 거래된 아파트 5채 중 1채 이상이 ‘6억원 이하’인 것으로 나타났다. 전셋값 급등에 대출 문턱마저 높아지자, 정책대출을 받을 수 있는 시세 6억원 이하의 집으로 매수세가 몰린 것으로 풀이된다.

headlines.title: 거래 말랐는데 신고가는 속출 …“ 2022년 급락장과는 다르다 ”
headlines.summary: 서울 아파트 거래량 석달새 62.8% 급감 역대 최고가 이어져…서울 외곽 급속 확산 가격하락 앞서 거래량 감소 과거 사례에도 “공급 부족·대출 제한에 시장 영향 제한적” 서울 아파트 매매 거래가 급감한 가운데, 신고가 거래는 곳곳에서 속출하고 있다. 하지만 시장에선 거래량 감소가 급격한 가격 조정으로 이어지긴 어려울 것으로 내다보고 있다.

headlines.title: 강남 넘어 오금동도 공사비 3.3㎡당 1000만원 육박
headlines.summary: ‘천정부지’ 치솟는 서울 재건축 공사비 송파구 오금현대 평당 962만원 제시 목동4·13단지 등 곳곳서 1000만원 공사비 급등에 분양가 1년새 34% 상승 반포·여의도·압구정 등 한강변 핵심 정비사업지를 넘어 서울 곳곳에서 3.3㎡(평)당 1000만원 안팎의 공사비 사례가 나타나고 있다.

headlines.title: [금융현미경]유가·금리·경기… 추석 전후 韓 환율 향방 최대 변수는

headlines.title: 인구감소 · 주택거래 둔화 … 8월 이동자 수 53년 만에 최소
headlines.summary: ▲ 서울 아파트 인구 감소 흐름에 주택 거래까지 둔화하면서 8월 국내 이동자 수가 같은 달 기준으로 53년 만에 가장 적었습니다. 국가데이터처가 오늘(23일) 발표한 '8월 국내인구이동 통계'를 보면 지난달 국내 이동자 수는 47만1천명으로 1년 전보다 4.5%(2만2천명) 감소했습니다.

key_headlines.title: OECD Raises Korea's 2026 Growth Forecast to 3.7% from 2.6%, Largest Upward Revision Among G20
key_headlines.summary: International organizations including OECD and ADB significantly raised Korea's economic growth forecasts, driven by strong semiconductor exports and anticipated consumer recovery. The semiconductor boom is expected to boost exports and production growth this year, with domestic consumption recovery anticipated from next year.

key_headlines.title: Korea's Tax Revenue Surges to Record 478.6 Trillion Won, Up 63.2 Trillion from Estimate
key_headlines.summary: Semiconductor boom and stock market rally are driving record tax revenue collections this year, with corporate tax contributing over half of the upward revision. The government's tax revenue forecast increased 15.2% from the previous estimate due to strong corporate earnings.

key_headlines.title: Won-Dollar Exchange Rate Falls to 1,350 Won Level as Semiconductor Exports Remain Strong
key_headlines.summary: The Korean won strengthened to the 1,350 level against the dollar due to strong semiconductor export performance, with oil prices emerging as a key variable affecting exchange rate movements. Expectations of eased US-Iran tensions and Saudi Arabian crude export expansion have contributed to lower oil prices.

key_headlines.title: Seoul Apartment Transactions Show 22% Below 600 Million Won as Buyers Seek Policy Loan Eligibility
key_headlines.summary: Over one in five apartment transactions in Seoul are now below 600 million won as buyers concentrate purchases on policy loan-eligible properties. High jeonse prices and stricter lending criteria are pushing residential demand toward lower-priced units.

key_headlines.title: Samsung Invests 1.4 Trillion Won in AI Infrastructure Company Helix
key_headlines.summary: Samsung is investing in Helix, an AI infrastructure company established by private equity firm KKR, signaling strategic moves in the AI infrastructure sector. This investment reflects Samsung's pivot toward supporting the growing power demands of AI data centers.

sections.Hot Economy News: International organizations have significantly revised upward Korea's 2026 economic growth forecast to 3.7% from 2.6%, the largest increase among G20 nations, driven by strong semiconductor exports and anticipated consumer recovery. The semiconductor boom is generating record government tax revenues of 478.6 trillion won, representing a 63.2 trillion won increase from previous estimates, with corporate tax contributing over half of the upward revision. The won-dollar exchange rate has strengthened to the 1,350 level as semiconductor exports remain robust, with oil price movements emerging as a critical variable affecting currency direction. Rising property prices and tight lending criteria are concentrating apartment transactions in Seoul toward units below 600 million won to secure policy loan eligibility. Korea's economic momentum is being driven by semiconductor strength while policymakers monitor potential concentration risks in this sector.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The National Assembly Budget Office projects Korea's real GDP growth at 2.7% for 2027, noting that export momentum will continue while domestic demand recovers, though cautioning about heavy semiconductor sector concentration risks. Record tax revenue of 478.6 trillion won is being collected this year, surpassing the supplementary budget estimate by 63.2 trillion won due to semiconductor industry prosperity and active stock market activity. Corporate tax collections are expected to reach 136.4 trillion won, far exceeding the initial 101.3 trillion won estimate, driven primarily by semiconductor company earnings. The government faces policy challenges balancing growth support with inflation management, as oil prices and international rate movements continue to exert pressure on Korea's economic outlook. Policymakers are monitoring whether the semiconductor sector strength can be sustained while developing strategies to reduce economic concentration risks.
sections.Financial Markets: The US Treasury bond market has experienced sharp rate increases, with 10-year yields reaching 5.293% and 30-year yields hitting 5.6206%, creating headwinds for equity markets including a two-day decline on Wall Street. The KOSPI opened up 1% to approach the 6,900 level while KOSDAQ rose 98 points to 854.78, driven by semiconductor stock purchases despite overnight US bond market weakness. The CME FedWatch shows a 70.3% probability of a US federal funds rate increase in October, with markets pricing in the possibility of three consecutive rate hikes through year-end. Korean government bond markets are experiencing volatility from surging US Treasury yields, prompting authorities to prepare emergency buyback measures if bond market stress intensifies. Market sentiment remains cautiously optimistic despite bond market turbulence, with expectations that Fed tightening cycles may pause after current rate increases as core inflation moderates.
sections.Industry & Technology: The semiconductor sector continues driving regional economic growth, with Seoul metro and Chungcheong regions posting around 5% growth in second-quarter regional GDP, while Honam region lags due to petrochemical industry weakness. Electric vehicle adoption is exposing infrastructure gaps including insufficient repair networks, battery safety concerns, and energy infrastructure challenges, with service network disparities particularly acute for foreign EV makers like Tesla. Korea's semiconductor and advanced technology sectors are gaining strategic importance as the government promotes venture capital development and considers negative regulatory approaches to nurture high-tech industries. Samsung's 1.4 trillion won investment in AI infrastructure company Helix reflects growing corporate focus on artificial intelligence and data center power requirements. Distributed AI implementation could unlock a 68 trillion won annual market opportunity for Korea by 2035, leveraging the country's digital infrastructure and semiconductor competitiveness.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul's Jungkok-dong in Gwangjin-gu is slated for redevelopment into a 2,200-unit residential complex with up to 35 stories, including 424 rental units, with improved connectivity to subway lines and waterfront amenities. Major reconstruction projects are accelerating including Hansol Apartments in Gangnam's Ilwon-dong expanding from 570 to 960 units, and projects in Yeongsan, Gangseo, and Mapo districts proceeding with enhanced development regulations. October 2026 is expected to see 45,691 apartment units released for sale across 60 projects nationwide, representing a 70.6% increase from September and a 171.8% surge compared to October 2025. The concentration of transactions in properties below 600 million won reflects policy loan eligibility thresholds, with concerns raised about the potential disappearance of affordable housing stock in Seoul. China is implementing first-time homebuyer support measures including 1 percentage point reductions in mortgage interest rates for five years to stimulate its struggling real estate market.
sections.International Economy: US Treasury bond yields have reached 24-year highs amid concerns about persistent inflation, creating pressure on the Federal Reserve to balance rate hikes with political considerations ahead of the November midterm elections. Market expectations now show 70.3% probability of a Federal Reserve rate increase in October and possibilities of consecutive hikes through year-end, though some Fed officials including New York Fed President Williams have signaled measured approach to further tightening. Trump administration tariff policy is showing flexibility, with reductions on agricultural products to address domestic political concerns while opening consumption goods export opportunities for China. The Federal Reserve faces conflicting signals with some officials emphasizing inflation persistence while others question whether AI productivity gains will justify continued monetary tightening. International bond market stress is transmitting to Korea and other economies, creating challenges for central banks managing inflation and growth simultaneously.
sections.AI & Economy: Former Minister of Science and ICT Jang Dong-hyuk emphasized that Korea risks lagging internationally due to political hesitation in AI policy implementation and called for accelerated advanced venture capital development and youth job creation. Distributed AI adoption offers Korea an estimated 68 trillion won annual market opportunity by 2035, with key investment areas including industrial AI deployment incentives, workforce skills transformation, distributed AI infrastructure, and semiconductor capabilities. Samsung's 1.4 trillion won investment in Helix reflects corporate recognition that AI data center expansion will dramatically increase electricity demand, driving strategic infrastructure development. KB Securities upgraded Samsung Electronics valuation outlook based on its AI infrastructure investment strategy, signaling positive market reception to semiconductor companies' pivot toward AI support. Game companies are rapidly adopting AI with 50% adoption rates among surveyed firms, with AI utilization capability emerging as a core competitive differentiator in the industry.
sections.Others: The Korea Customs Service eliminated upper limits on whistleblower reward amounts and introduced progressive payment structures offering up to 3x multipliers for insider reports, aiming to maximize program effectiveness against increasingly sophisticated smuggling and tax evasion. The Ministry of Labor conducted searches targeting a primary contractor on suspicion of union disruption activities, continuing government enforcement efforts against illegal labor practices. The government enacted new immigration control regulations effective mid-September restricting international travel for personnel involved in technology export violation risks, particularly affecting tech and semiconductor sectors. Game industry AI adoption has reached approximately 50%, representing significant technological transformation with implications for workforce skills and competitive positioning. Sixty-three new chemical substances were registered in the third quarter 2026 with identified hazard and risk information, of which 22 showed confirmed harmful or dangerous properties requiring regulatory monitoring.
